steps: curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/ms-vscode.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ms-vscode.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code stable main' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list && apt update && apt install -y code
